'''Sector Command''' was a division of the [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military]] that helped oversee military operations during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Its members included [[General/Legends|generals]] from the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]], who would confer with field [[Commander/Legends|commanders]] to coordinate front-line campaigns.
